Priya (CS): Hey team, we need a compact customer-facing runbook that explains staged warm pools, adaptive TTLs, and quick recovery steps. one page for kickoff packs.
Ethan (Solutions): Make it action-oriented: recommended defaults, a small config snippet, and a 2-line troubleshooting command.
Marta (Eng): Suggest we call out adaptive TTL: start 1h, drop to 15m on sensitive data, ramp to 4h for heavy reuse. include warm-pool sizing guidance.
Priya (CS): Draft bullets: - Staged warm pools: small warm pool (5 entries) at go-live, scale to 25 during steady traffic. - Adaptive TTLs: 3600s default; reduce to 900s for PII workflows; increase to 14400s for high reuse prompts. - Prefill pipeline: upstream corpus -> dedupe -> prompt-hash -> prefill job. - On-demand preference: use when prompt variance >60%.
Noah (PM): Add renewal/health signals: 1) 2-week rolling drop >30% in active sessions -> schedule CSM check. 2) NPS or feedback fall >1 point between week1 and week3 -> prioritize playbook audit. 3) missed two smoke tests -> escalate to SE.
Ethan (Solutions): Paste-friendly config for customers:
```yaml
runtime_defaults:
  warm_pool_initial: 5
  warm_pool_target: 25
  ttl_seconds: 3600
  adaptive_ttl:
    pii: 900
    high_reuse: 14400
  client_debounce_ms: 120
  server_batch_max_wait_ms: 60
  streaming_threshold_tokens: 280
```
Marta (Eng): Dev notes: - Warm-pool sizing: average concurrent warm entries = expected concurrent sessions * reuse_ratio. start small. - KV key: tenant|env|prompt_sha|ver. - Batch window tradeoff: 20-60ms low-latency, 60-200ms for throughput.
Priya (CS): Feedback capture: short survey at day 7 + day 30. day7: 1) Relevance 1-5 2) Latency ok? y/n 3) Anything blocking? (short). day30: NPS + two open ended items.
Ethan (Solutions): Troubleshooting quick check (one-liner):
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/{tenant}/metrics?window=5m" | jq '.throughput, .latency_p95, .warm_pool_hit_rate'
```
Marta (Eng): Recovery steps (3 bullets): 1) If stale responses after model update: increment schema ver in KV and flush warm pool. 2) If warm-pool miss spike: temporarily increase server_batch_max_wait_ms to 120ms and enlarge warm_pool_target. 3) If latency p95 increases >2x: switch to dedicated capacity or reduce batch window.
infra-bot: deploy/finished cs-staged-warmpool-playbook-v0.1 by ethan at 2025-01-14T15:02:00Z :white_check_mark:
Priya (CS): Great — I'll convert this to a 1-pager and attach the two survey templates. can someone confirm the streaming token threshold wording?
Marta (Eng): 2-liner: "Streaming keeps a socket open and increases CPU; enable for interactive UX or responses >250 tokens. For short inference calls (<120 tokens) prefer non-streaming to cut compute cost."
Priya (CS): Thanks all — I'll push to onboarding materials and call this out in tomorrow's kickoff. :white_check_mark:
